about:
Kitchen Local, LLC operates a certified shared-use commercial kitchen in Amesbury, Massachusetts. Founded in 2013, the facility occupies 2,200 square feet within 14 Cedar Street Studios, a historic brick building that once housed Chas. J. Henschel & Co., a carriage and automotive manufacturer. The building sits a few blocks from downtown Amesbury at the intersection of the North Shore and Merrimack Valley regions, just over the New Hampshire border. The company is a member of the Amesbury Chamber of Commerce & Industry.

The kitchen provides around-the-clock access to permitted commercial kitchen work and storage space for food entrepreneurs. It serves chefs, bakers, small-scale food producers, farmers, and cooking and nutrition instructors who use the facility for food production, catering, baking, cooking classes, menu planning, training, recipe testing, photography, and product development. Kitchen Local guides participant businesses through permitting and licensing, connects them with resources, assists with business concept and strategic planning, and helps promote their businesses. The company also offers a 90-minute confidential consultation session for prospective or early-stage food businesses.

The facility serves culinary professionals and food startups across the North Shore and Merrimack Valley areas. Its participant businesses include food producers, caterers, bakers, and instructors who need affordable, permitted kitchen space without large capital investment. The collaborative environment fosters a community of food entrepreneurs.

Kitchen Local was established to fill a niche for culinary professionals by minimizing risk and start-up costs, allowing food businesses to launch or expand immediately without significant initial capital investment.
